title: The Final Threshold | ECHO//100 Episode 90
description:
Kavi stands before the ultimate gateway to a world where his war never existed. To secure peace, he must leave his closest allies behind in the collapsing void. Episode 90 of ECHO//100: The Door War. This is an original work of fiction created with the assistance of artificial intelligence.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The Nexus fractures, revealing a shimmering, liquid gateway pulsing with the light of forgotten stars.
scenes.caption: The gateway opens
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing before a swirling, blindingly bright liquid portal in a dark void.

scenes.text: Every version of Kavi merges into one, yet the weight of collective pain remains heavy.
scenes.caption: Kavi's unified consciousness
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's face, his glasses reflecting dozens of overlapping, faint silhouettes of himself.

scenes.text: This threshold leads to a reality where the Door War never happened, though memories fade.
scenes.caption: A forgotten history
scenes.image_prompt: The gateway showing a peaceful, sunlit park scene through the shimmering surface of the portal.

scenes.text: Kavi alone retains the burden of the cost of the fight and the lives lost.
scenes.caption: The lonely survivor
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking down at his backpack, his expression solemn as the portal illuminates his red hoodie.

scenes.text: Mira and the merged Byte and Null step forward, blocking the path to the light.
scenes.caption: The final stand
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal coat standing beside Byte's cyan-faced form and Null's glitching black-purple silhouette.

scenes.text: They command Kavi to enter the golden glow while they hold the anchor steady alone.
scenes.caption: The ultimate sacrifice
scenes.image_prompt: Byte and Null glowing intensely as they physically grip the edges of the unstable, tearing gateway.

scenes.text: Kavi crosses the threshold as the reality behind shatters into white static during the reset.
scenes.caption: Crossing the line
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi stepping into the blinding light, his silhouette blurring as the world around him dissolves.

scenes.text: Silence claims the void until a familiar phone rings out, and Kavi answers the call.
scenes.caption: One final call
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing in a white void, holding a classic phone to his ear, his eyes wide with realization.
